title: Set_Attribute_Single with compact write data
purpose: Exercise a write-style CIP common service with class, instance, and attribute path segments plus a short service-data body.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse the valid explicit-message transport and then process or reject the single-attribute write request at CIP level.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length is 0x001c and matches 28 command-specific bytes.
SendRRData uses interface handle and timeout before CPF.
CPF item_count is 2 with Null Address Item then Unconnected Data Item.
Unconnected item length is 12 and matches the CIP bytes.
Service code 0x10 is the documented Set_Attribute_Single service.
Path-size byte 0x03 matches the class-instance-attribute path.
issue_safety_notes: This seed is valid and compact, leaving payload growth to later mutations rather than forcing aggressive writes.
